WITH facility_resources AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fac_key,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN f.com_res IN ('Comprehensive', 'Extensive') THEN 3
            WHEN f.com_res = 'Adequate' THEN 2
            WHEN f.com_res = 'Limited' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) as frai
    FROM facilities f
    GROUP BY f.fac_key
),
facility_tar AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fac_key,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN tb.med_adh IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Compliant') THEN 1 END)::float / COUNT(tb.tx_key) as tar
    FROM facilities f
    JOIN clinicians c ON f.fac_key = c.fac_connect
    JOIN patients p ON p.clin_lead_ref = c.clin_key
    JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
    JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
    GROUP BY f.fac_key
),
combined AS (
    SELECT fr.frai, ft.tar
    FROM facility_resources fr
    JOIN facility_tar ft ON fr.fac_key = ft.fac_key
)
SELECT 
    CORR(frai, tar) as craa
FROM combined;

WITH facility_resources AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fac_key,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN f.com_res IN ('Comprehensive', 'Extensive') THEN 3
            WHEN f.com_res = 'Adequate' THEN 2
            WHEN f.com_res = 'Limited' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) as frai
    FROM facilities f
    GROUP BY f.fac_key
),
facility_tar AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fac_key,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (t.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh') IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Compliant') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / COUNT(t.tx_out_key) as tar
    FROM facilities f
    JOIN clinicians c ON f.fac_key = c.fac_connect
    JOIN patients p ON p.clin_lead_ref = c.clin_key
    JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
    JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
    JOIN treatmentoutcomes t ON t.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
    GROUP BY f.fac_key
),
combined AS (
    SELECT fr.frai, ft.tar
    FROM facility_resources fr
    JOIN facility_tar ft ON fr.fac_key = ft.fac_key
)
SELECT CORR(frai, tar) as craa
FROM combined;
